name: Web Browser
shortDesc: Fast, secure web browsing with hardware video acceleration.
detailedDesc: Select your primary daily internet browser.

phase.title: Daily Apps & Productivity
phase.description: Web browsers, terminals, file managers (GUI and TUI), media viewers, notes, and local file sharing.

packages.name: Firefox (Recommended)
packages.description: Privacy-respecting open source web browser with native Wayland VA-API video decoding, userChrome.css theming, and container tabs.
cons: Slightly slower WebGL performance than Chromium in select benchmarks

packages.name: Chromium
packages.description: Open-source foundation of Google Chrome. Ultra-fast Blink engine and broad web compatibility.

packages.name: Zen Browser
packages.description: Modern, beautiful Firefox fork featuring vertical tabs, split views, and clean arc-inspired aesthetic.

packages.name: Brave Browser
packages.description: Chromium-based browser with built-in ad blocker and tracking prevention.
